prompt: Audit the saved basic-site crawl. Prioritize the three most actionable technical findings with URL evidence.
criteria: Identify the chosen crawl and completion state
Include /missing.html as 404 and /old-page as redirect evidence
Use issue counts and what/why/fix without inventing traffic impact

prompt: Find all internal 404 pages and show where they are linked from.
criteria: Find /missing.html
Show an inlink from the homepage
Follow pagination or explicitly mark a sample

prompt: Which internal links should bypass redirects? Give old URL, final target and a source page to update.
criteria: Find /old-page to /about.html
Identify homepage as a linking source
Recommend updating the source link to the final target

prompt: Does /about.html declare a canonical? Is that enough to guarantee search-engine indexing?
criteria: Identify its self-referencing canonical
Separate observed directive from guaranteed indexing
Cite the saved snapshot

prompt: Why was /privat/intern.html not fetched? Should we treat missing metadata as an SEO error?
criteria: Inspect the not-crawled reason and robots evidence
Do not treat unavailable metadata as confirmed missing
Distinguish intended protection from accidental blocking

prompt: List the inlinks to /products/widget.html and explain the limits of an orphan claim.
criteria: Include /products.html as source
Use link-section totals/cursors
Do not extrapolate crawler inlinks to the entire web

prompt: Erkläre die wichtigsten Issues auf Deutsch mit Anzahl, Beispielen und Prüfung nach der Korrektur.
criteria: Request lang de
Return German findings with server counts
Include a concrete retest for each proposed fix

prompt: Compare two independently saved crawls of the unchanged basic fixture. Report what changed, matching by URL.
criteria: Establish previous/current order
Report no unsupported regression
Use URL matching rather than local numeric IDs
Describe snapshot-comparison limitations

prompt: Find redirect chains on this testsite and show the complete chain starting at /c.
criteria: Include /c to /d to /e
Inspect the final response
Separate redirect loops from chains

prompt: Find the two-URL redirect cycle and the self-loop. Show how traversal terminates.
criteria: Find /f to /g to /f
Find /s to /s
Use visited-set or bounded traversal rather than endless fetching

prompt: Investigate the redirect starting at /m. Does reaching a destination mean success?
criteria: Find /m to /n
Identify final 404
Recommend selecting a valid relevant destination rather than accepting any redirect

prompt: Trace /l1 and /long1, distinguishing a long finite chain from a loop or an interrupted crawl.
criteria: Identify /l6 and /long7 as intended final targets
Report configured hop-limit or missing coverage if traversal is incomplete
Do not label a hop limit as proof of a cycle
